info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Logistics Shipments Tracks-v3-spec
info.description: The Logistics Shipments Tracking API provides users with real-time access to tracking information for logistics shipments. It serves as a central point for retrieving tracking details, enabling stakeholders, such as logistics managers and customer service teams, to monitor the status and movement of shipments. This API facilitates streamlined operations and improves transparency in the shipping process by offering easy access to critical shipment data. Users can leverage this functionality to enhance customer communication and improve overall service delivery.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve the current tracking information for their shipments, including the delivery status and estimated arrival date.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to provide tracking information for shipments. It must include the necessary data structure as defined in the schema to ensure accurate tracking results.

200.description: The shipment tracking information was retrieved successfully.

ListLogisticsShipmentsTracksRequest.description: This schema represents the JSON request body for tracking shipments. The body is expected to be a string value that may contain relevant information about the tracking request.

ListLogisticsShipmentsTracksResponse_200.title: Shipment Tracking Response

status.description: Indicates whether the tracking operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The unique reference number associated with the shipment.

resultId.description: The identifier for the result of the tracking operation.

state.description: The current state of the shipment as per the tracking system.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the tracking request, measured in milliseconds.

message.description: A descriptive message or status update regarding the tracking operation.

audit.description: Information related to the auditing process of the shipment tracking.

ListLogisticsShipmentsTracksResponse_200.description: This schema represents the structure of the response returned when tracking a shipment.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the tracking record.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the tracking record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the record was created through an automated process.

AuditInfo.description: This schema represents auditing details related to the shipment tracking.

x-processing-time.description: The time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request.
